items.title: Sacramento’s Maxime Raynaud getting some good burn in this France vs Sweden Olympic qualifier.
items.author: Mark Jones
items.body_excerpt:
Sacramento’s Maxime Raynaud getting some good burn in this France vs Sweden Olympic qualifier. 
Sets a good screen for the bucket here. 
He’s got 7 pts and 3 Rebs so far

items.title: France dominated an undermanned Slovenia team. Slovenia fouled repeatedly in the paint. Victor Wembanyama, Rudy Gobert and Maxime Raynaud combined to shoot 26-for-28 on free throws. That was pretty much the story of the game.
